Rajasthan Congress leaders address internal party dynamics

Rajasthan Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot has responded to statements made by Congress state president Govind Singh Dotasra. Gehlot addressed concerns about internal party "groupism" and Dotasra's remarks regarding "self-branding." He offered his perspective on his relationship with Dotasra and clarified his position on the internal party situation. The statements were made in response to perceived friction and public comments within the state Congress unit.
